At Ecolab, we help make the world cleaner, safer and healthier .
Ecolab is a trusted partner at nearly three million customer locations in more than 170 countries and a global leader in water, hygiene and infection prevention solutions. We combine complete solutions, data‑driven insights and personalised service to help customers improve food safety, maintain safe environments, optimise water and energy use, and drive sustainable performance across food, healthcare, hospitality and industrial sectors.
If you are early in your career and looking to learn, grow and make a real impact, our Territory Manager in Training Programme could be the right next step.
About the Programme
This is a 12 month, structured development programme designed to prepare you for a future role as a Territory Manager. Starting from October 1st, 2026 you will be supported every step of the way through a combination of:
Classroom and virtual learning
On‑the‑job training and job shadowing
Coaching from experienced colleagues
Hands‑on experience with customers in real environments
From day one you’ll gain exposure to customer operations, learn how to diagnose challenges, and develop practical solutions that improve safety, hygiene and sustainability.
About the Division
Within the Water division (Nalco Water, an Ecolab company), Ecolab delivers water treatment, process and digital water management solutions to help customers improve operational performance, protect critical assets and advance sustainability goals. Our solutions support customers across industrial, manufacturing, food and beverage processing, power generation, energy, mining, data-centers and commercial facilities, from water intake through reuse and discharge.

After completing your training, you will take ownership of an established customer territory, becoming a trusted partner and technical advisor to your customers. You will provide expert guidance on water treatment, process optimisation and digital water management programs that help improve operational performance, protect critical assets and support safe, efficient and sustainable customer operations.

Build strong, trusted relationships with existing customers through regular service visits
Learn how customers’ systems work, gaining hands-on experience with equipment, technologies and solutions used in their daily operations
Support the installation, maintenance and safe use of equipment, helping customers keep their facilities fully operational
Train and support customer teams, making sure they feel confident using Ecolab solutions
Gradually develop the ability to spot improvement opportunities, deliver technical demonstrations and support the growth of your assigned territory
Work closely with colleagues across different teams (Sales, Marketing Services, Customer Service) to deliver the best possible customer experience
Contribute to Ecolab’s growth by supporting outreach activities and helping build our brand in your local market
What you’ll need?
We are interested in meeting individuals with diverse backgrounds. You may be a great fit if you:
Have completed technical / scientific education (Ideally in Chemical Engineering or Chemistry)
Are interested in building a career in technical, sales or service-related roles
Are eager to learn, open to feedback and motivated to continuously develop new skills
Have demonstrated problem solving skills and creative thinking
Are comfortable adapting to new situations and challenges
Have basic IT skills (Microsoft Office)
Have at least a B1 level in English
Hold a valid driver’s license, with an acceptable Motor Vehicle Record, and are open to traveling within your assigned district and occasionally nationwide
No Immigration Sponsorship available

A 12month fixed-term contract, that may lead to a permanent position, depending on business needs
A robust, structured training programme, that includes job shadowing, e-learning modules, structured field activities, and customized classroom style training, with clear development milestones
A supportive environment where coaching and feedback are part of everyday work, allowing you to learn from subject matter experts with proven success
The opportunity to carve out a long term, advanced career path in sales, within a business that recognises the talent to progress
25 days holiday plus 8 days Bank Holiday
4% Flexible Benefits Allowance. A wide range of benefits (extended to families) or to be used as salary increase
Pension with 7% Employer Contribution and 4 x annual salary Life Insurance benefits
Receive a company vehicle for business and personal use
Income growth opportunities as you progress and develop in the role
Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion
At Ecolab, we believe the best teams are diverse and inclusive, and we are on a journey to create a workplace where every associate can grow and achieve their best. We are committed to fair and equal treatment of associates and applicants.

We recruit, hire, promote, transfer and provide opportunities for advancement on the basis of individual qualifications and job performance.

In all matters affecting employment, compensation, benefits, working conditions, and opportunities for advancement, we will not discriminate against any associate or applicant for employment because of race, religion, colour, creed, national origin, citizenship status, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity and expressions, genetic information, marital status, age, disability, or status as a covered veteran.

About Atira
Atira builds the commercial brain for industrials. Our agents 10x the sales engineers of today by offering the complete toolbox of tasks needed in complex environments. They handle everything from extracting and classifying requirements from incoming RFQs, orchestrating communication and information retrieval across multiple stakeholders and systems, while generating outcomes like documentation, production system inputs, or configuration recommendations. CRM. Atira. ERP.
We are one of the fastest growing teams in Munich and are looking for you to join us!
Why this role compounds
Sales is the one skill that compounds across every career path. Whether you become a founder, a closer, or a senior commercial leader, the people who got there learned the craft early. Atira is where you learn it right.
You will be one of the first persons we hire in our GTM team. This means you will define how Atira finds, qualifies, and engages customers across our key verticals. This role goes well beyond what you would do at any other early stage startup looking for BDRs right now. We are looking for someone who is up for a real challenge in a fast moving environment and in return can become an Account Executive at Atira within the next 8-12 months.

s.h: How the role sits in the team
s.t: As Atira scales, we build industry-specific "pods" at the heart of our GTM approach: Forward Deployed Engineer, Account Executive, BDR, Product Marketer, and a GTM Engineer. The BDR sits at the front of the pod, working hand-in-hand with the GTM Engineer and AE to bring success stories from existing customers to new ones. The story flywheel starts with you.

We have some of the highest profile enterprise customers and are building the story around them. In parallel our team is growing fast to meet the inbound demand we are currently getting across customer segments and sizes.
We are now heavily scaling our GTM Team and are looking for founding team members to re-define how industrials sell complex products.

Building the outbound engine. You design the sequences, test the channels (phone, email, LinkedIn, events), and figure out what works even better at industrial customers. The global playbook starts now, you help write it
Work closely with our Forward Deployed Engineering Teams. You will be the story teller of our deep and impactful Enterprise engagements. No mass blasts. We are working with the industry leaders in each sub vertical. You will know more about a customer's sales & engineering process than most of their own sales engineers before the first meeting.
Customer outreach. You will speak with industrial leaders & Sales Engineers across different industrial verticals and be a key person within the initial sales process together with founders and Account executives.
Become AI-native in your craft. You proactively identify where AI accelerates outbound work, you experiment with new approaches, and you share what works with the rest of the team
Feed learnings back into product and marketing. What objection comes up in 70% of cold calls? Which ICP segment responds best to which message? You are the ground truth on what the market actually says, and that signal flows back to our founders, the AE, and the product team

Hunger, structure, and the kind of resilience that does not wilt after seven dial-tones in a row. Problem-solving, creativity, and drive matter more than the right number of years on your CV. We have hired strong people from non-traditional backgrounds before. We will confidently do it again.
That said, the following references give a guideline of what we typically see in strong candidates.
Your profile
You are motivated to build something from the ground up. You take ownership of work others would delegate and finish what you start
Fluent in German and English
Ideally, concrete evidence of hitting outbound targets in a prior role. If you don't have prior experience, you compensate with a serious side hustle, sales-heavy student initiative, or another track record of convincing people to do hard things
AI-native outbound: you have built your own research and personalisation stack and know how to scale personalisation without it becoming spam
Genuine curiosity about manufacturing and industrials. You don't need to know what a defense or aerospace RFQ involves on day one, but you need to be the kind of person who will know in week three. Ideally, you have already looked it up by reading this
What you'll get
Real ownership. You'll be one of the first BDRs and contribute to the playbook from day one. What works for the next five hires will be what you figured out
Close collaboration with our co-founder Florian (ex-Palantir DACH commercial lead). You iterate the playbook with him, benefitting from his experience
Validated traction. Leading Industrial customers including several with revenues above €1B within a clearly defined ICP. You are not hunting in the dark
Clear AE pathway. Strong BDRs move into an AE seat within 12-18 months. For this strategic hire we have a fast track
AI-native sales stack. Attio, Apollo, plus whatever else helps you close. We get you the tools you need
Competitive base equity package, uncapped variable. OTE designed so over-performance is real money, not symbolic
Central Munich office. Vibrant in-office culture additional benefits including Wellpass, JobRad and dinners
Most importantly: Collaborate & thrive in a high-performing but caring culture. We will own the industrial sales function but will do so with modesty and integrity
What success looks like after a few months
You have co-built the first version of the outbound playbook: named sequences per ICP segment, tested openers, working objection handlers
You have multi-threaded into multiple named accounts on your own, with key stakeholders engaged at each
You drive our pipeline beyond the current hype we already experience

Werde Teil eines Abenteuers, das stetig wächst
Decathlon in der Schweiz ist eine echte Success Story, die 2017 in Neuenburg begann. Seither haben wir jährlich rund zehn neue Filialen eröffnet und zählen heute über 50 Verkaufsstellen. Und wir denken gar nicht daran, zu bremsen! Unsere Expansion geht weiter – besonders in der Deutschschweiz. Das bedeutet für dich: Eine spannende Möglichkeit in unserer Filiale in Stans.
Warum diese Stelle deine Chance ist
Du liebst Velos, berätst gerne Kundinnen und Kunden, hast aber auch kein Problem damit, mal das Werkzeug in die Hand zu nehmen? Perfekt! Wir suchen ein Allround\-Talent für eine Mischposition aus Verkauf und du handwerkliches Geschick, technisches Verständnis und eine grosse Portion Begeisterung mitbringst, bist du bei uns genau richtig.

s.h: Deine 3 grossen Vorteile auf diesem Posten
s.t:
Die perfekte Abwechslung: Kein Tag ist wie der andere. Mal stehst du auf der Verkaufsfläche und findest das Traum\-Velo für ein Kind, mal bist du in der Werkstatt und machst ein Bike startklar.
Lernen on the job: Du musst kein Profi\-Mechaniker sein. Wir zeigen dir die präzisen Handgriffe, damit du kleinere Services, Einstellungen und Reparaturen selbstständig und sicher durchführen kannst.
Volle Integration: Du bist von Tag eins an ein vollwertiges Mitglied unserer Equipe in Stans. Du übernimmst Verantwortung und gestaltest den Erfolg unserer Filiale aktiv mit.
Dieser Job ist NICHTS für dich, wenn...
Du dich nur auf eine Sache konzentrieren willst (wir suchen jemanden, der sowohl den Verkauf als auch den Service mag).
Dir der Kundenkontakt ein Graus ist und du dich lieber den ganzen Tag in der Werkstatt versteckst.
Du starre «Top\-down»\-Strukturen brauchst und darauf wartest, dass andere alle Entscheidungen für dich treffen.
Du nicht bereit bist, am Samstag zu arbeiten (denn genau dann sind unsere Sportlerinnen und Sportler am meisten auf uns angewiesen).
Dein Alltag bei uns (Deine Aufgaben)
Beratung \& Verkauf: Du bist die erste Ansprechperson in unserer Velo\-Abteilung. Du erkennst die Bedürfnisse der Kunden und verkaufst Bikes samt passendem Zubehör.
Service \& kleine Reparaturen: Du machst die Fahrräder für die Kundschaft startklar (Montage, Einstellungen von Schaltung/Bremsen, Zubehör anbringen) und führst einfache Sicherheitskontrollen durch.
Warenpräsentation: Du sorgst dafür, dass die Verkaufsfläche glänzt, die Bikes sauber präsentiert werden und die Regale immer gut gefüllt sind.
Profil: Was wir von dir erwarten
Erfahrung \& Quereinstieg: Du hast idealerweise Erfahrung im Verkauf oder einfach ein grosses Herz für den Radsport. Deine Leidenschaft und dein handwerkliches Geschick zählen!
Serviceorientierung: Du hilfst Menschen gerne und hast Freude daran, sowohl beratend als auch praktisch anzupacken.
Zuverlässigkeit: Bei der Sicherheit machen wir keine Kompromisse. Du arbeitest gewissenhaft, sauber und organisiert.
Teamgeist: Du packst ohne Zögern auch mal an der Kasse oder in anderen Abteilungen mit an, wenn Not am Mann ist.
Sportbegeisterung: Du treibst selbst aktiv Sport und kennst dein Material. Das macht deine Beratung authentisch.
Sprachkenntnisse: Du beherrschst Deutsch perfekt (Hauptsprache in unserer Filiale in Chur). Jede weitere Sprache ist ein Plus.
Was wir dir bieten
Als festes Mitglied der Decathlon\-Familie profitierst du von attraktiven Vorteilen (auf Basis eines 100%\-Pensums):
Bonus : monatlich zwischen 0 und 10%
Vorteile: 25 % Rabatt auf alle Decathlon\-Produkte und ein sportliches, motiviertes Arbeitsumfeld.
Einzigartige Teamkultur: Flache Hierarchien, das sportliche „Du“ auf allen Ebenen und ein hochmotiviertes Arbeitsumfeld, in dem deine Meinung zählt
Entwicklungschancen: Viele unserer Führungskräfte haben auf der Verkaufsfläche angefangen. Wir bieten dir kontinuierliche Schulungen (z.B. zu Produktneuheiten oder Verkaufstechniken) und hervorragende interne Aufstiegsmöglichkeiten
Der Ablauf: Wie wir uns kennenlernen

About Omtera
Omtera is an AI deployment and enterprise technology company helping leading organisations across EMEA turn world-class technology into real, production-ready business solutions.

We design and deliver AI deployment, customer engagement, product analytics and work-management projects using technologies from companies such as OpenAI, Anthropic, ElevenLabs, FinAI, Braze, Snowflake, Asana, Mixpanel, OneSignal and some others.

Our teams work with globally recognised organisations including NEXT, Qatar Airways, ELM Company, Mobily, Intel and Delivery Hero , supporting complex enterprise projects from initial discovery and commercial design through implementation, adoption and expansion.

We are now looking for a commercially ambitious Sales Executive to help grow our AI and SaaS solutions business across EMEA. Tasks This is a broad, consultative sales role covering both subscription-based SaaS solutions and AI deployment projects.

You will identify potential customers, understand their business challenges, develop opportunities and work alongside Omtera ’s technical consultants and Forward-Deployed Engineers to create solutions that customers can confidently buy and deploy.

Depending on your experience, you may join us as an early-career Sales Executive ready to develop quickly, or as a more experienced Account Executive capable of owning opportunities independently. This is not a scripted sales role.

You will need to understand technology, ask intelligent questions and connect customer challenges with the right commercial and technical solutions.

Approximately 50% of your working day will require fluent English , both written and spoken, including customer meetings, internal collaboration, proposals, presentations and communication with international technology partners. What You Will Do
Build and manage a pipeline of AI deployment, SaaS subscription and professional services opportunities across EMEA.
Identify and engage relevant decision-makers through outbound prospecting, networking, events, partner referrals and inbound opportunities.
Conduct discovery meetings to understand customer objectives, technical environments and commercial priorities.
Position solutions involving OpenAI, Anthropic, ElevenLabs, FinAI, Braze, OneSignal, Asana, Mixpanel and other leading technology platforms.
Work closely with solution consultants and Forward-Deployed Engineers to shape proposals, demonstrations, pilots and deployment plans.
Manage the sales process from initial contact through qualification, proposal, negotiation and closing.
Develop clear commercial proposals covering subscriptions, implementation services and ongoing support.
Maintain accurate opportunity, activity and forecast information in the CRM.
Build long-term relationships with customers and identify renewal, expansion and cross-sell opportunities.
Collaborate with international partner and vendor sales teams on joint opportunities and go-to-market initiatives.
Continuously improve your understanding of AI, SaaS, enterprise technology and the industries we serve.

s.h: Requirements What We Are Looking For
s.t:
At least one year of experience in B2B sales, business development, account management, partnerships or a similar customer-facing role.
Experience selling or supporting the sale of SaaS subscriptions, cloud solutions, consulting services, implementation projects or other technology solutions.
Professional-level English with strong written and verbal communication skills.
Confidence communicating with both business and technical stakeholders.
A genuine interest in AI, enterprise software and emerging technologies.
The ability to learn new products quickly and explain their business value clearly.
A proactive and disciplined approach to prospecting, follow-up and pipeline management.
Comfort working with targets and a compensation structure consisting of a base salary and performance-based commission.
Strong presentation, negotiation and relationship-building skills.
The ability to take ownership while collaborating closely with commercial and technical teams.
You May Be a Strong Fit If
You are early in your career but have already demonstrated strong commercial potential.
You currently work as a Sales Executive, Account Executive, Business Development Representative, Sales Development Representative or Account Manager.
You want to move from selling a single product into a broader AI and enterprise technology environment.
You are commercially driven but also curious about how technology is implemented and used.
You want exposure to enterprise customers, international technology companies and complex projects.
You are looking for a role where strong performance can lead to significantly greater responsibility.

A competitive base salary with a clear performance-based commission structure.
The opportunity to sell some of the world’s most relevant AI and SaaS technologies.
Direct exposure to enterprise customers and international opportunities across EMEA.
The chance to work closely with experienced consultants, solution architects and Forward-Deployed Engineers.
Structured development across prospecting, discovery, solution selling, negotiation and enterprise account management.
Significant career progression opportunities based on performance and ownership.
Access to partner training, product certifications and industry events.
A fast-moving environment where good ideas and strong results are recognised.
The opportunity to help shape Omtera ’s growing AI deployment business.
Hiring Process Our hiring process is designed to be practical and transparent:
An introductory conversation to discuss your experience, motivation and expectations.
A commercial interview focused on your sales approach, communication skills and understanding of technology solutions.
A short practical exercise or customer scenario.
A final conversation with Omtera ’s leadership team.
You do not need to know every technology we work with before applying. We are interested in candidates who combine commercial ambition, curiosity, discipline and the ability to learn quickly. Apply If you want to build a career at the intersection of enterprise sales, SaaS and AI deployment , we would like to hear from you.

Please apply with your CV and a short note explaining why this opportunity interests you and what type of technology or solution-selling experience you would bring to Omtera . Originally posted on Himalayas

At David Zwirner, we look to be an industry leader in our field, with our artists at the center of what we do. Our global exhibition program expands beyond our locations in New York, London, Los Angeles, Hong Kong, and Paris, representing over seventy artists and estates.

Home to innovative, singular, and pioneering exhibitions across a variety of media and genres. Active in both the primary and secondary markets, David Zwirner has helped foster the careers of some of the most influential artists today.

s.h: Who will work well with us
s.t:
The ideal candidate is someone who is passionate and interested in the arts/larger creative arena or is eager to learn.
We welcome all individuals entering the workforce, those moving into a new stage of their career or vocation, making a change, returning to work, and those wanting to learn and grow within the industry, to apply.
About the Opportunity
Sales Assistant to Senior Partner
David Zwirner seeks a full-time Sales Assistant to work alongside one of the gallery's Senior Partners. The Sales Assistant will fulfill administrative assistant duties as well as liaise with curators, artists, and clients for the Senior Partner.
Superior writing skills, the ability to time manage and meet deadlines, and a thorough working knowledge of contemporary art are required. This position will involve significant contact with artists and long time clients and other art industry professionals therefore discretion and poise are essential. This position may be scheduled Mondays - Fridays or Tuesdays - Saturdays depending on gallery needs.
Candidates must be diligent, extremely organized, and possess excellent time management and communication skills.

s.h: Support Senior Partner with roster of artists
s.t:
Assist with general artist management of artists’ studios and estates, with exhibitions, requests, press, image requests, general studio requests, events, appraisals and artist care.
Monitor all artists’ solo/group exhibitions, both domestic and international, manage checklists and loans.
Support with gallery exhibition planning globally.
Liaise with other gallery staff regarding all aspects of inventory & exhibition management: production, shipping, framing, photography, research, etc.
Create and manage client lists for exhibition previews/dinners, support Director during openings.

s.h: Provide broad sales support to Senior Partner
s.t:
Manage Senior Partner's sales, help create sales offers, coordinate and prepare for client viewings and prepare insurance appraisals.
Conduct post-sale tasks including preparing invoices and coordinating shipping.
Manage the Senior Partner's secondary market consignments, prepare consignment and contract agreements; liaise with clients on cataloging and research materials, and create presentations for client offers and significant works.
Work across departments to ensure secondary market artworks have photography, provenance and all other relevant documentation.

Daily management of Senior Partner’s calendar, agendas, to-do list and help set daily priorities and goals. Prepare travel arrangements, itineraries, appointments and expenses.
Responsible for organising the Senior Partner's inbox, and staying on top of all communication requests.
Liaise frequently with multiple departments within the gallery to oversee projects such as exhibition and art fair booth models, gallery exhibition checklists, online viewing rooms, sales previews, and press packets, among others.

s.h: What we would like you to have
s.t:
2-3 years in an assistant or administrative support role at a gallery.
Experience supporting senior leadership with calendar management and travel itinerary.
Detail oriented with experience in managing upwards.
Strong multi-tasking skills with the ability to prioritize and anticipate needs as well as organisational skills.
Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to work cross-departmentally.
Strong interest in sales.
Passion for and knowledge of contemporary art.

s.h: What you will love about David Zwirner
s.t:
David Zwirner has pioneered initiatives dedicated to the gallery’s long-standing commitment to kaleidoscopic storytelling, including: David Zwirner Online , David Zwirner Books , Dialogues , Utopia Editions , and Consignments .
Premier Access - to private on-site and off-site events, such as exhibition previews, book signings, talks, and walkthroughs with gallery artists and estate members, and external curators and scholars.
Staff-driven projects and fundraising initiatives. This includes David Zwirner's commitment to Galleries Commit .

## Office de la formation professionnelle | 70-80 % | Coire ##
L'Office de la formation professionnelle (OFP) est un service du Département de l'éducation, de la culture et de la protection de l'environnement (DEPE) et met en œuvre les mandats éducatifs de la Confédération et du canton dans le domaine de la formation professionnelle initiale. Il est également un centre de compétence pour les questions d'orientation professionnelle, scolaire et universitaire ainsi qu'une instance d'accompagnement tout au long de la carrière professionnelle.
Le département Orientation professionnelle, études et carrière (OPEC) conseille et informe personnellement, de manière indépendante et gratuite les jeunes et les adultes sur les questions de profession, d'études et de carrière. L'OPEC soutient dans le choix de la profession, des études ou de la carrière et accompagne dans la planification de l'avenir professionnel.
Nous recherchons pour l'Office de la formation professionnelle à partir du 1er janvier 2027 ou selon accord un/e conseiller/-ère en orientation professionnelle, études et carrière (70-80 %).

* Conseil et information des jeunes et des adultes dans le choix de la profession, de l'école et des études ainsi que dans la conception de la carrière professionnelle
* Soutien des clients à utiliser leurs propres ressources, à agir de manière autonome et à prendre des décisions indépendantes
* Entretien de la collaboration avec les enseignants des niveaux secondaires I et II ainsi que des écoles secondaires supérieures et écoles professionnelles pour la préparation au choix de la profession et la conception de la carrière
* Organisation d'événements d'information pour les parents et les classes
* Maintien régulier des contacts avec les écoles, les institutions éducatives, les centres de compétence et l'économie
* Participation à des projets et groupes de travail internes

* Compétences en conseil et information ainsi que connaissances spécialisées en psychologie, théories du choix professionnel, des études et de la carrière
* Présentation compétente et convaincante devant les jeunes et les adultes, les parents et les enseignants
* De préférence connaissance des structures économiques régionales ainsi que du marché du travail

**Du willst die Energiewende auf die Dächer bringen?**
Younergy Solar ist ein Unternehmen für erneuerbare Energien, das Photovoltaik\- und Energielösungen für Unternehmen, öffentliche Institutionen und Privatkunden in der ganzen Schweiz entwickelt und realisiert. Wir verbinden technisches Know\-how mit Lösungen, die für unsere Kund wirtschaftlich sinnvoll sind – von der ersten Analyse bis zur schlüsselfertigen Anlage.
Unser Ziel ist nicht, nur über die Energiewende zu sprechen. Wir setzen sie um – Projekt für Projekt, Dach für Dach.
Zur Verstärkung unseres Wachstums in der Deutschschweiz suchen wir eine erfahrene Vertriebspersönlichkeit mit nachweisbarem Leistungsausweis im B2B\-Verkauf. Bei Younergy Solar akquirierst und berätst Du in erster Linie Unternehmen, Industriebetriebe, Landwirtschaftsbetriebe, Gemeinden und Immobilienverwaltungen in der Deutschschweiz – ergänzt durch punktuelle Privatkundenprojekte.
**Was Du bei uns machst**
Geschäftsentwicklung, aktive Akquise und Kundenberatung stehen im Zentrum Deiner Rolle.
\- Du identifizierst und akquirierst aktiv neue B2B\-Kunden (KMU, Industrie, Landwirtschaft, Gemeinden, Immobilienverwaltungen) in der Deutschschweiz und baust Dir einen eigenen Kundenstamm auf
\- Du berätst zusätzlich B2C\-Kund bei ihren Energiewende\-Projekten, telefonisch, digital und vor Ort
\- Du entwickelst technische und kommerzielle Angebote, die auf die jeweilige Situation zugeschnitten sind, verhandelst diese bis zum Verkaufsabschluss und begleitest das Projekt anschliessend bis zur finalen Abrechnung
\- Du steuerst Deinen Verkaufszyklus eigenständig, von der Lead\-Qualifizierung über die Präsentation bis zur Vertragsunterzeichnung
\- Du baust ein Netzwerk aus relevanten B2B\-Partnern (Installateure, Planer, Verbände) auf und pflegst es aktiv
\- Du koordinierst Dich eng mit unseren Teams aus Technik, Operations, Marketing und Finanzen
\- Du trägst mit eigenen Ideen dazu bei, Prozesse, Angebote und Verkaufstools laufend zu verbessern
\- Du vertrittst Younergy an Messen, Ausstellungen und Fachveranstaltungen in der Deutschschweiz
**Was Du mitbringst**
Wir suchen eine erfahrene Vertriebspersönlichkeit mit nachweisbarem Erfolgsausweis und Netzwerk, kein Berufseinstieg.
\- Mindestens 3–5 Jahre Erfahrung im B2B\-Verkauf mit aktiver Neukundengewinnung, idealerweise im Bereich Photovoltaik, erneuerbare Energien oder technische Anlagen
\- Nachweisbarer Leistungsausweis: erreichte Verkaufsziele, Grösse der betreuten Kundenportfolios oder abgeschlossene Projektvolumen
\- Erfahrung in der eigenständigen Führung komplexer, mehrmonatiger B2B\-Verkaufszyklen – von der Akquise bis zum Vertragsabschluss
\- Technische Ausbildung im Bereich Elektrizität/Energie oder betriebswirtschaftlicher Hintergrund mit ausgeprägter Affinität zu technischen Energielösungen
\- Sicherer Umgang mit digitalen Tools und CRM\-Systemen
\- Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse und ösisch\- und/oder Englischkenntnisse auf mindestens Niveau B2
\- Strukturierte, selbstständige und zielorientierte Arbeitsweise mit hoher Eigenmotivation zur Akquise
\- Verhandlungsgeschick, Abschlussstärke und die Fähigkeit, auf Entscheidungsträgerebene (Geschäftsleitung, Gemeinderat) zu überzeugen
\- Regelmässige Reisebereitschaft in die Deutschschweiz
**Was Du von uns bekommst**
\- Ein attraktives Fixgehalt mit leistungsorientiertem, ungedeckeltem Bonus auf Basis Deiner Verkaufsergebnisse
\- Ein Firmenfahrzeug
\- Spannende Aufgaben an der Schnittstelle von neuen Technologien, Energie, Vertrieb und Projektmanagement
\- Viel Freiraum, um Deinen eigenen B2B\-Kundenstamm und Deine Verkaufsansätze aufzubauen
\- Flexible Arbeitsbedingungen
\- Ein multikulturelles Team, das mit Begeisterung ins Büro kommt und Kund besucht
\- Ein Unternehmen, das wächst und in dem Du sichtbar etwas bewegen kannst
\- Die Möglichkeit, die Energiewende in der Schweiz mit konkreten Projekten voranzutreiben
**Interessiert?**
Dann uns Deine Bewerbung. Wir möchten wissen, welche B2B\-Verkaufserfolge Du bisher erzielt hast, wie Du an die Akquise von Energielösungen herangehst und warum Younergy zu Dir passt. Über ein kurzes Video würden wir uns auch freuen.
